title: ColorPickerButton 's Picker popup shows up in the wrong window when opened on a native window child, making it unusable
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 
- v4.4.stable.official [4c311cbee]
- v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.4.stable - Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (nvidia; 565.77) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-8300H CPU @ 2.30GHz (8 threads)

### Issue description

When using a ColorPickerButton, all the pickups/popups related to it will appear in Main Screen and when you try to interact with it it closes.

Heres a clear view of the bug:
*note its on the main window and not its own window.
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/afb2fb61-4aa1-40d5-bf61-b3ba050f363b)

Heres what that looks like in a running project:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/21853749-52fc-46a2-9efd-f99df0623a2e)

### Steps to reproduce


Add a Window node, then set `flags > force_native` to true in the inspector.
Hide the window node. (so that it opens as a native window later)

Add a Button Node. 
On the Button Connect `pressed()` to the Window's `Show()`

Then add a ColorPickerButton Node as a child of the Window.
Change the text variable to `color`, in order make it easier to see.

Run the Scene, click the button Node.
The windows opens up, then click the ColorPickerButton.
Now look for the Color Picker popup, you will notice its on the Main Window.
If you try to interact with it should close, making impossible to use.

it should look like this 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/dd52d7bf-ccd8-4e7c-b2ff-ac4f098e97e6)


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This a Scene that reproduces the bug, just put it in the project, run it, click the Button, click the ColorPickerButton on the window, and see the bug.

[color_picker_button_on_native_window_bug.tscn.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20785283/color_picker_button_on_native_window_bug.tscn.txt) *note: Uploaded as a txt beacuse github doesnt like TSCN
